section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1994
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1994 N.C.R.B. - 20 1.1.2 Although the annual growth of 'Accidental Deaths' at compound rate has been estimated to be 4.0 percent during 1984-94, it is observed that during 1994 there was a decline of 1.0 percent in such deaths compared to those in the previous year. The main contributory factor for this decline has been the substantial decrease to the tune of 60% in the 'Accidental Deaths' by natural causes. There was, however, a marginal increase of 2.6 percent in these deaths, due to un-natural causes in 1994.
